MICHEL CLAEYS BOUUAERT

Michel Claeys

Belgian Psychotherapist · Founder of Essence Therapy · Practitioner of dreamwork and emotional intelligence education

ABOUT MICHEL

Consulting, Teaching and Writing

Michel Claeys (Michel Claeys Bouuaert) was born in Belgium and studied law and criminology in his early years before turning to education, counseling and personal growth. He has been engaged in psychological counseling and professional training for a long time, integrating humanism, transpersonal psychology and body-centered working methods into practice, and gradually formed Essence Therapy.

Since the end of 2000, he has focused his work in Beijing, conducting lectures and training in Chinese universities and psychological professional institutions. The courses of dreamwork, Essence Therapy and emotional intelligence education subsequently entered more cities; Chinese books provided sustainable reading texts for these methods.

WORK & WRITING

Several directions for continued work

01

Essence Therapy

Starting from the current physical feelings, identify the inner space of injury and resources, and carry out consultation and teaching.

02

dreamwork

Use the dreamer's own experience as the starting point for understanding dreams, and then explore the connection between dreams and real life.

03

Emotional Education

For educators, parents, and group leaders, develop learning methods that can enter the classroom and relationships.

04

Chinese works

From Counseling from the Heart (《由心咨询》) to The Truth of Dreams (《梦的真相》), the discussion and communication of methods continue in the text.

BEYOND THE CLASSROOM

Deepening methods in practice

Consulting, writing, on-site demonstrations and long-term leadership together make up the work of Michel Claeys. For learners, after understanding the concepts, they also need to understand the boundaries and applications of the methods through on-site practice and reflection.
